explanation: Shrunk 2-body high-mass/high-G (m~17,18 G~4.73) with dt~0.0177 undergoes very close encounter ~0.35-0.39 at steps 22-23 inside/near softening (0.3). Potential deepens to ~-3216 and kinetic to ~2638. Substeps increase to 13-16 but are insufficient to resolve the strong acceleration; leapfrog error accumulates. Energy is -483 at step 22, jumps to -577 at step 23 and -620 at step 24, exceeding the 2%+0.05 energy_conserved envelope (allowed 117, change 137). Reducing dt to 0.005 while keeping everything else identical restores energy conservation, confirming dt/integration resolution is the cause.
vision_note: Two blue bodies execute an extremely close, near-merging encounter near the top-center, appearing almost overlapped in steps 22-23 before pulling slightly apart at step 24. Their short, tightly curved trails indicate very rapid approach and strong deflection during the close pass.
